forgotPassword.title: Resetting the password
forgotPassword.body: Whoever set this device up can clear the password. On the device (plug in a keyboard), or from another computer using a terminal, run:
forgotPassword.fallback: If that command isn't there, deleting the file {file} in the Home Screens folder does the same thing.
forgotPassword.after: Home Screens then opens without a password, and you can set a new one in Settings.

launcher.heading: Where do you want to go?

remote.title: Family remote
remote.body: Chores, meals, timers, and the displays

editor.title: Editor
editor.body: Design your screens. Works best on a laptop or desktop.

launcher.editorAddressHint: Open this address on a laptop to design your screens:

family.title: Family
family.emptyDescription: Add the people in your household. They will be available in chores, rewards, calendars and school timetables.
family.conflict: Someone changed the family while you were editing. The latest roster is shown. Please make your edit again.
family.removeDescription: Removing {name} clears their chore assignments, schedules, completion history, ticket balance and reward access, and forgets which calendars are theirs. Chores with no one left are deleted. This cannot be undone.
family.limit: You can add up to {count} people. Everyone already here stays and can still be edited or removed.
family.removeTimetable: {name} has a school timetable, and it is removed as well.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Put people together so a calendar can show "Kids" instead of five names, and a chore can go to all of them at once. A person can be in more than one group.
groups.name: Group name
groups.duplicateName: You already have a group called {name}.
groups.removeDescription: Screens that show only {name} go back to showing everyone. Nobody is removed from the family.

removeChoreCount.one: {count} chore goes to {name}. It stays in your list, and waits for you to pick someone if nobody else is on it.
removeChoreCount.other: {count} chores go to {name}. They stay in your list, and any with nobody else on them wait for you to pick someone.

groups.limit: You can have up to {count} groups.
groups.hint: Groups are used by the calendar's color key and its "show only" filter. A chore can go to a group too. Rewards still assign to people.

customIcons.emptyHint: Add your own picture, like a photo of Grandma's lasagna.

review.title: Add your own icon
review.preview: This is how it will look on the screen.
review.wide: This picture is very wide, so it will look small. A square picture works best.
review.tall: This picture is very tall, so it will look small. A square picture works best.
review.tiny: This picture is very small and may look blurry.

errors.too-big: That picture is too big. Pick one under 5 MB.
errors.not-a-picture: Only pictures work here (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF).
errors.picture-too-large: That picture is too large to use. Pick a smaller one.
errors.animation-too-big: That moving picture is too big. Try a shorter one.
errors.library-full: You have 300 icons, which is the most you can keep. Remove one you don't use to make room.
errors.budget-full: Your icons are using all of their space. Remove one you don't use to make room.
errors.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.svg-drawing: Drawings saved as SVG can't be used. Save it as a PNG first.

customIcons.formats: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB.

page.title: Your icons
page.description: Pictures your family added. Use them for meals, chores, rewards, people and routines.
page.empty: No icons yet. Add a picture to use it for meals, chores and more.
page.tapHint: Tap a picture to rename or remove it.

inUse.one: It is used in {count} place, which will switch to a standard icon.
inUse.other: It is used in {count} places, which will switch to a standard icon.

backup.help: The pictures you added for meals, chores, rewards, people and routines. Leave this off to keep the file small.
backup.missing: Some meals and chores used your own icons, which were not in this backup. They will show the usual picture instead.
backup.leftOut: Saved, but your icons could not be added. Try again to include them.
backup.leftOutWhenOff: Your pictures will be left out
backup.restoreNoIcons: This backup doesn't include your pictures. Meals and chores that used them will show a standard picture.

customIcons.photosPrompt: Want your own pictures for meals and chores?
